rows.summary: The 2026 Item 11 restructures initial training from an 11-day program with up to two other attendees to a 3-day program with one other attendee plus a 50-hour internship, introduces mandatory NMP and NSS advertising programs and a $20,000/$10,000 grand opening advertising requirement, raises the BaseCamp computer support fee from $250 to $350 per month, and adds site-selection deadlines, store-opening deadlines, and termination rights absent from the 2022 disclosure.
